Emma (PM): Quick sync — customers are asking for stricter contract enforcement for structured outputs. We need a recommendation: per-route opt-in vs tenant-wide toggle. Also how should SDKs expose validation + retry?

Raj (Eng): Per-route opt-in. Default should be permissive (warn) so we don't break existing users. SDK should expose a validationMode param.

Liam (ML): Agree per-route. We also need a recovery path: on validation fail we can retry with a constrained prompt or softer schema. Decide attempts.

Sofia (DevEx): Proposed SDK shape: generate({ model, prompt, validation: { mode: 'strict'|'soft'|'off', retry: { attempts: 1, backoff: 'exp', jitter: true } } })

Marta (CS): Narrow ask from two enterprise customers: auto-fix-and-retry for small issues (missing optional fields, minor type mismatches). Prefer 1 automatic retry.

Raj (Eng): Implementation note: do server-side post-response validation. If failure and retry.allowed -> re-invoke model with an augmented prompt: "You must return valid JSON matching X schema. Fix the previous response." Limit attempts to 2 to bound cost.

Emma (PM): Launch checklist we should track: docs + SDK change, per-route config in Console, e2e tests using representative schemas, observability (validation_failure_rate, retry_attempts, retry_success_rate), privacy review, and canary rollout (10%).

Sofia (DevEx): Error UX: return machine-friendly error object in response when validation fails. e.g.:
```
{"validation_error":"type_mismatch","path":"/items/0/price","message":"expected number, got string","suggestion":"coerce to number or remove currency symbol"}
```
Also include human message + link to docs.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC :rocket:

Raj (Eng): Backoff numbers proposal: exp backoff 200ms -> 400ms -> 800ms, with 20% jitter. Keep max attempts 2 (1 retry). OK?

Liam (ML): OK but add SLO safety: if estimated remaining latency would violate route SLO, skip retry and surface the validation error.

Emma (PM): Decision summary (short): per-route opt-in; default mode = warn; server-side post-validate; default auto-retry = 1 attempt with exponential backoff + jitter; cap retries when SLO/cost thresholds hit; surface detailed machine error + human-friendly text; metrics and canary required. Action: Raj to draft runtime PR, Sofia to update SDK + error docs, Dev to prepare e2e tests. Deliverables due EOD Wed.

Marta (CS): Can we add a toggle for customers in Console (per-route) so they can flip strict on/off? That would help enterprise buyers.

Sofia (DevEx): Yes, we can expose per-route toggle in the Console. I'll add a UI mock (figma) and link in #product-design.

Emma (PM): Small follow-up: do we need a migration path for users who currently parse output heuristically? Raj?

Raj (Eng): We'll provide a compatibility guide: enable warn mode first, run in canary and check validation_failure_rate and sample failures. Recommend customers fix most common patterns before flipping strict.

Liam (ML): Also add a model-fallback policy: if strict fails repeatedly, route to a more deterministic model or a template-based postprocessor. Add that to runtime playbook.

Emma (PM): Great. Thanks all — will summarize and attach to the initiative doc. :thumbsup:
